product.description: SlimRun™ AV is the next generation in active optical cable systems. It features completely redesigned electronics to connect a USB-C® device to a USB-C display with the highest performance, lowest power consumption, and lowest cost over the greatest distance. Using optical fiber to replace copper wire as the high-speed signal transmission medium, SlimRun can perfectly transmit 4K@60Hz video to distances up to 100 feet. Compared with traditional copper wire, SlimRun AV HDR is not only longer, softer, and slimmer, but also offers better signal quality without the use of external power.
